questions.prompt: The parent starts a helper to review a 3,000-line file. What ends up in the parent's own event log?
options: The whole file plus the helper's answer
Every tool call the helper makes
Only the subagent tool call and a short result saying the helper started
Nothing, because helpers are invisible to the parent
questions.explanation: The child records its reading and tool calls in its own log. The parent's log gains only the tool/call and the tool/result "Started child-1."

questions.prompt: Why does the subagent tool return at once instead of waiting for the child's final answer?
options: Waiting would break the event log format
So the parent can start several helpers in one reply and they run side by side
Because children are not allowed to finish
Because the model cannot read long tool results
questions.explanation: A waiting tool blocks the parent's turn, so helpers would run one after another. Returning at once lets several run at the same time.

questions.prompt: A fresh child is started with the brief "fix the bug we discussed". What goes wrong?
options: Nothing, it reads the parent's history
The child knows only the brief, so it does not know which bug
The child asks the person which bug and waits
The tool rejects briefs under 100 characters
questions.explanation: A fresh child starts with an empty log and only the brief. The brief must be complete; only a forked child would carry the parent's history.
